$comment: The versioned application motion grammar (#56). Durations and the curve are generated tokens; this file owns which properties may animate where, the flow recipe's arithmetic, the ambient budget, the reduced-motion doctrine, and the named exemptions. A motion value not derivable from this file plus ledger-tokens is a defect, not a choice. Deliberately named motion-grammar: the motion/ directory is the HyperFrames video layer (one master clock, seekable, no wall time) and the two must not blur.

notGoverned.index.js animation: pre-Ledger website vocabulary; deprecated in 4.4.0, see compatibility.json
notGoverned.slide-base.css --f-stagger: the deck layer; decks are rendered to PDF, not browsed
notGoverned.motion/: HyperFrames video: one master clock, seekable, no wall time; governed by motion/contracts/*

t300.role: transition · hover lifts, hairlines, surface tints

t600.role: entrance · fadeUp, dialog enter, flow stages

t900.role: narrative · the page's one expressive moment; the flow core

breathe.role: ambient settle pulse · the pinned centre of the ambient cycle family

properties.note: Compositor only, no layout properties. Carriers stay transform-only so the frozen state IS the composition; UI motion may also fade because a component has content a carrier does not.

ambient.perViewportNote: Must equal atmosphere.json limits.animatedPerPage: a breathing carrier and the aurora spend the same budget, and the two grammars keep one ledger between them.

flow.boundsNote: Two is a toggle and seven is a process diagram; neither is the loop.
flow.settleNote: v1 settles static only. A near-static pulse on the core is the named follow-up, and it ships WITH a rendered fixture spending the ambient budget or it does not ship: an unverified code path has no place in a contract whose whole point is rendered proof.

beacons.phase: deterministic from peak index i: duration (7 + ((i * 3) % 5))s · delay -(((i * 71) % 100) / 100 × duration)s
beacons.phaseNote: The breathe token is the pinned centre of this family: validateMotionManifest asserts it lies inside durationsSeconds, so the token cannot drift away from the cycles it names.

reducedMotion: final-state: prefers-reduced-motion renders the composed end state immediately; no sequencing, no loops, nothing hidden; kills are scoped to governed roots, never a page-global star
trigger: one host-added class, is-flowing, from the published MOTION_TRIGGER_SNIPPET; the snippet arms the page by stamping data-motion-armed on the root BEFORE observing, so pre-reveal hiding exists only while an observer is demonstrably watching. Without the snippet nothing is ever hidden. Scroll-driven animation-timeline: view() is verified working in headless Chrome but scrubs with scroll — a narrative sequence must not run backwards when the user scrolls up — so it stays a documented option for simple reveals, never the flow's trigger.

exemptions.reason: a spinner reads only at constant angular velocity
shipped in components v1; the rewrite to a translated gradient layer is a named follow-up, not a silent grandfather
shipped in components v1; a scaleX refactor breaks consumers reading the bar's box
